component.name: Marker
component.summary: Write Markdown with a live preview

description.p: Marker is a Markdown and plain-text editor with a preview that updates as you type.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, footnotes and task lists
Tabs, a file explorer, recent files and a document minimap
Find and replace with regular expressions, and search across a folder
Keeps each file's encoding and line endings, and saves atomically
Follows changes made by other programs and remembers your session

description.p: Documents are rendered in a sandboxed view: HTML in a Markdown file cannot run scripts or read other files.
